title: Detour Michigan Activation #1
body: On a trip out to Detour Michigan with the family. Grandparents used to live up here, we try to make it out once a year. First year I've brought my radio. Hoping to activate detour state harbor and harbor island. Harbor island will be a bit logistically complex since I've gotta either activate from the boat or swim my stuff to shore. Should be fun.
Got my KX2 out here at the rental today.
New antenna, had it delivered to my parents house in Michigan so I wouldn't have to fly a vertical whip across the country and lose it to TSA.
A picture of the rental from the water. Nice place, best spot so far since the grandparents sold the house a long time ago.
Hope to hear yall on the air. 73
